messages:
mira: Heads-up — noticed a spike of CreateGrant events for the KMS key used by backups around 12:34 UTC. Grants were issued with TTLs of 7d to the backup-uploader role, which is longer than our standard 1h ephemeral policy. No RBAC changes in the audit log that explain this. @tom can you look?

encops-bot: detected 8 CreateGrant events for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234 from principal backup-uploader between 2024-05-10T12:33:40Z and 2024-05-10T12:35:10Z. Alert ID: encops-1204.

tom: on it. quick q: do we have CloudTrail entries for those CreateGrant calls?

mira: I pulled a partial CloudTrail extract — see below. Notice requestParameters.grantTokens is empty and response shows "RetiringPrincipal": null. Also there are no corresponding IAM PolicyChange events.

mira: ```json
{"eventTime":"2024-05-10T12:34:02Z","eventName":"CreateGrant","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/backup-uploader/i-0abc"},"requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234","granteePrincipal":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-uploader","operations":["Encrypt","Decrypt","GenerateDataKey"]},"responseElements":{"grantId":"g-0a1b2c3d","constraints":null}}
```

dev: hmm, backup-uploader rotates its agent creds hourly but the agent code has a fallback path that requests a persistent grant if it sees transient failures. That fallback was added last month during a flaky network window. I thought the code limited grants to 1h, though.

jess: dev — which PR added the fallback? can you link the commit? we need to see the TTL value being passed to CreateGrant.

dev: PR #3214 — commit 7f3b2e. snippet: ```python
# fallback to persistent grant on repeated EIO
kms.create_grant(KeyId=key_id, GranteePrincipal=role_arn, Operations=['Encrypt','Decrypt','GenerateDataKey'], RetireOnDelete=False, Name='backup-agent-grant', GrantTokens=[])
```

mira: there we go — no TTL param passed, so KMS default grant lifetime applies (until revoked or key rotation). This is the bug. The code should create a grant with a limited expiration mechanism (we use short lived grants + grantTokens).

ana: (cc @ana) Ana, risk assessment — any sign these grants were used to access other tenant buckets? We saw one suspicious PutObject on a different archive prefix at 12:36.

ana: I ran quick S3 access logs mapping — there is a PutObject from backup-uploader at 12:36:17 to s3://archive-prod/tenant-42/dump.sql.enc. That bucket is supposed to be tenant-scoped. Need to confirm if the principal had cross-tenant permissions via IAM or via a mis-scoped role.

tom: I checked role policy: backup-uploader has a wildcard s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::archive-prod/* (it was meant to allow uploading to tenant prefixes but policy has a missing condition on aws:ResourceAccount or s3:prefix). Oof. RBAC mis-scope + persistent grant = exposure vector.

mira: Proposed immediate actions: 1) Revoke all active grants for key abcd-1234 that match Name contains "backup-agent-grant". 2) Temporarily disable backup-uploader role sessions (revoke session tokens). 3) Roll back the fallback commit in PR #3214 and patch to pass explicit grantTokens/short TTL pattern. 4) Audit uploads for 12:30-13:00 and notify affected tenants.

encops-bot: Created ticket ENCOPS-4521: "revoke persistent backup grants + RBAC scope fix" assigned to eng-security and eng-sre.

jess: I can take the patch. I'll prepare a quick fix: enforce GrantTokens flow and set an explicit monitor that fails CI if create_grant is called without allowed pattern.

dev: I'll open a rollback PR and add unit tests. Also adding a pre-commit linter rule to catch raw create_grant calls without the helper wrapper.

tom: I'll run revocation commands in staging, then prod if green. revocation cmd I plan: ```bash
aws kms retire-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234 --grant-id g-0a1b2c3d
```

mira: forensics checklist: collect CloudTrail CreateGrant/RetireGrant, IAM AssumeRole logs, S3 access logs for 12:00-14:00, and object metadata for uploaded files. Also get list of tenants whose prefixes had writes.

ana: I ran a quick scan — three tenant prefixes had writes: tenant-12, tenant-42, tenant-93. Notify security + support to prepare outreach.

ana: ETA for revocation?

tom: staging done in 15m, prod in 45m once rollback merged and smoke tests pass. I'll post status here.

mira: thanks. after this we should add a scheduled check that detects any CreateGrant without a correlating grantToken issuance path and flag it. Might be a rule in our config policy engine.

jess: agreed. also filing a postmortem owner now (mira), linking ENCOPS-4521.

mira: assigning myself. Will draft timeline and impact. Thanks all :shield:

tom: prod revoke complete. no further writes after 12:40.

mira: starting tenant notifications draft, will share in #customer-notify for legal review.

encops-bot: ENCOPS-4521 status updated -> prod-mitigation-done.

mira: follow-up action items: short-term patch (jess/dev), policy fix for S3 uploader (tom), CI rule (jess), detection rule (mira). We'll reconvene in 1d for postmortem.

dev: thanks team, will push rollback now.

jess: PR merged and canary passed. rolling to prod in 10. :rocket:
